method: imagegen redraw with simpler matte palette; standard lossless WebP import; pixel bounds measured without editing source pixels
prompt: Redraw this exact atlas as SIMPLE, UNDERSTATED, hand-authored 48x48 pixel-art game inventory sprites. The game is a modest cozy winter pixel village, not a high-definition fantasy loot game. Reduce the design complexity noticeably: about HALF the interior marks and ornament, clearly larger square pixel clusters, each individual sprite logically only 48x48 pixels and a limited palette. Two or at most THREE shades per material, flat matte surfaces, restrained desaturated warm color. Dark brown 1-logical-pixel stepped outline. All diagonals and curves visibly stair-step on the same coarse pixel grid. Treat every highlight as at most one small flat rectangular cluster. REMOVE shiny glossy 3D reflections, white glare, bevel-rich trim, gold filigree, repetitive tiny binding rings, micro stitching, tiny hatch marks, paper mottling and fine woodgrain. Brass should be muted ochre with just one light edge, NOT bright yellow polished gold. Paper should be flat cream with 1 fold shadow and at most 3-4 broad ink bars. Leather is flat muted burgundy/brown/teal with one simple shadow. Absolutely NO smooth gradients, antialiasing, blur, painterly detail, dithering, random scattered pixels, grain, or noisy texture. This must read as an actual low-resolution 16-bit game sprite, designed for seeing it at 48px, not a detailed illustration reduced in size. Keep every object's important identifying shape and story clue, but delete cosmetic richness. Preserve the exact original ROW/COLUMN order, grid and CANVAS SIZE, each object within its own current cell. Fit each object inside the central 75-80 percent of its cell, leave broad truly transparent clean space around it so no neighbours touch. No tile backgrounds, no frames, no labels/numbers, no decorative glow/halos or stray edge dots. Retain true transparent alpha, with clean crisp edges. Do not draw any characters or portraits. Keep blank cells blank.
